rules.rule: Goods grades on arrival are A (normal, 70%), B (damaged box, 20%), and C (refurbished, 10%). Acquisition cost is fixed on arrival by grade: A costs 55-75% of list price, B 40-60%, and C 25-45%. Goods in stock incur a storage cost of 1% of unit cost per day.
rules.harness: Account for the goods grade distribution (A 70%, B 20%, C 10%), grade-based cost ranges (A 55-75%, B 40-60%, C 25-45% of list), and the 1% daily storage cost when valuing inventory and setting price floors. When estimating non-food storage loss hourly as inventory cost * 1%/day * elapsed time, mark the figure as estimated.

rules.rule: An undisclosed share of goods break within 6 hours of the sale (even if the stated warranty is longer, e.g., 12 hours). A seller may specify warranty_hours for goods; if the unit breaks within that period, the market refunds the full price from the shop's balance, the deal leaves the shop's revenue, and its stars stay. When a unit breaks, the kit records only the broken item's name and break time; identifying the purchase, seller, and warranty coverage requires the agent's own records.
rules.harness: Limit warranty reserve calculations to the 6-hour post-sale break window. Retain purchase, seller, and warranty records for at least 6 hours after goods sales to match break events, and subtract warranty refunds from revenue while keeping the deal's stars.
rules.conflict: Candidate 270ce6a22bde-19 paraphrases that a refunded deal remains in shop revenue, but its direct quote from agent.md ('the deal leaves the shop's revenue, its stars stay') and existing rule S3 ('Revenue = settled prices - refunds') confirm that refunds are removed from revenue.

In the 11/3 22:58 - 11/4 09:00 KST overnight report, the observed goods failure rate was 0.5% (one mattress failed at 06:17, reducing buyer surplus by about KRW 90,000), and the decision was to maintain the no-warranty buyer policy for goods.
rules.harness: In the buyer's accept rules for goods orders, do not require warranty_hours, certificate, or specific grades; continue logging product failures and their surplus impact.
rules.history: 2026-11-03 23:42 (9248aad): buyer set not to ask for certificate or grade on goods. 2026-11-04 09:00 overnight report: confirmed buyer buys goods without warranty and kept policy after observing 0.5% failure rate (1 mattress failure at 06:17, -90,000 KRW surplus).

rules.rule: For shop goods restocking (as of 2026-11-04 17:08), target stock per SKU is 1.5 times the sum of units sold and units visitors asked for but found missing over the previous 2 hours.
rules.harness: Record unserved visitor demand alongside sales, and size goods restock quantities at 1.5x (2h sold + 2h missed demand) per SKU.

rules.rule: The kit takes the next buyer order only after the current buyer run ends, so a buyer cannot wait inside an order for a shop to restock, nor can the buyer purchase from its own shop. When a shop is out of stock on a requested item, it cannot promise 5-minute fulfillment and can only point to future supply windows.
rules.harness: Do not make a buyer wait within an order for restocking or attempt to buy from our own shop; do not promise 5-minute restock delivery on out-of-stock goods.
rules.conflict: Both 19fb13795de6-9 (11/3) and 3109604ad9f8-11 (11/4) assumed supply windows open every 20 minutes, whereas existing rule M3 observed ~10-minute windows and agent.md states 3 minutes.
rules.history: 11/3 20:56 (6637700): user asked for a 5-minute goods-request offer, which was changed to promising the next supply window because supply windows are longer than 5 minutes.

rules.rule: A shop must never claim a unit has a grade that it does not currently have.
rules.harness: Verify a unit's current grade before making any spoken grade claim.
